name: VAYA Resort Kühtai
beschreibung: The VAYA Resort Kühtai is situated at an elevation of approximately 2,000 meters in the Ötztal region, surrounded by the stunning Tyrolean Alps. The resort pairs modern architectural design with alpine charm, offering ski-in/ski-out convenience and direct access to hiking trails. Guests can expect spacious rooms, a relaxing wellness area, and gourmet regional cuisine—ideal for an active mountain retreat.
